'''''Da'tsang''''', meaning "despised one" in the [[Old Tongue]], is a term among the [[Aiel]].

==Description==
A person who has been made ''da'tsang'' is forced to wear uncomfortable black wool robes and toil uselessly on unnecessary tasks. ''Da'tsang'' are never allowed to do anything worthwhile unless there is great need. Being made ''da'tsang'' is considered extremely shameful and is reserved for thieves, liars, and criminals. One becomes a ''da'tsang ''once three different Wise Ones say "You are da'tsang", although the more formal process includes a trial where twelve Wise Ones sit in court.<ref name=comp>[[The Wheel of Time Companion]], Aiel law.</ref>

==Known ''da'tsang''==
[[Isendre]] was made ''da'tsang'' by ''[[Far Dareis Mai]]'' after [[Lanfear]] framed her for the theft of some necklaces.{{ref/book|5|7}} [[Galina Casban]] was also made ''da'tsang'' by the [[Wise One]]s of the [[Shaido]]. The Tower [[Aes Sedai]] involved in secretly capturing Rand in Cairhien that were taken prisoner after the [[Battle of Dumai's Wells]] were also made ''da'tsang'', although that status was revoked when they swore fealty to [[Rand al'Thor|Rand ]] and it was decided that they had suffered enough.{{ref/book|7|40}}
